statement: The canonical source path MUST be repository-relative and POSIX-separated.
note: An ABSOLUTE path to a record inside a repository MUST canonicalize to its repository-relative POSIX spelling. Substitute a real repository root for `<REPO_ROOT>` when running this fixture. This is what makes an identity reproducible across clones: hashing the absolute spelling makes every node id machine-specific, so the same record ingested via an absolute path forks the node a relative re-ingest produces.
